data analyst.title: data analyst
data analyst.description: Data analysts import, inspect, clean, transform, validate, model, or interpret collections of data with regard to the business goals of the company. They ensure that the data sources and repositories provide consistent and reliable data. Data analysts use different algorithms and IT tools as demanded by the situation and the current data. They might prepare reports in the form of visualisations such as graphs, charts, and dashboards.

business analyst.title: business analyst
business analyst.description: Business analysts research and understand the strategic position of businesses and companies in relation to their markets and their stakeholders. They analyse and present their views on how the company, from many perspectives, can improve its strategic position and internal corporate structure. They assess needs for change, communication methods, technology, IT tools, new standards and certifications.
essential: analyse financial performance of a company
optional: support implementation of quality management systems
shape organisational teams based on competencies
keep updated on the political landscape
propose ICT solutions to business problems

problem: analyse financial performance of a company

database administrator.title: database administrator
database administrator.description: Database administrators test, implement and administer computer databases. They use their expertise in database management systems to plan, coordinate and implement security measures to safeguard computer databases. They also use scripts and configuration files to tailor a database to users' needs.

ICT security administrator.title: ICT security administrator
ICT security administrator.description: ICT security administrators plan and carry out security measures to protect information and data from unauthorised access, deliberate attack, theft and corruption.

ICT help desk agent.title: ICT help desk agent
ICT help desk agent.description: ICT help desk agents provide technical assistance to computer users, answer questions or solve computer problems for clients via telephone or electronically. They provide assistance concerning the use of computer hardware and software.
essential: keep up to date on product knowledge

online marketer.title: online marketer
online marketer.description: Online marketers use e-mail, internet and social media in order to market goods and brands.
optional: deal with pressure from unexpected circumstances

environmental scientist.title: environmental scientist
environmental scientist.description: Environmental scientists identify problems and find solutions in order to minimize environmental hazards by performing analysis on samples such as air, water or soil. They advise on or develop environmental policies and aim to improve water supplies preservation and manage waste disposal sites. Environmental scientists perform environmental risk assessments and analyse the environmental impact of new solutions, construction sites or environmental changes ensuring the environmental regulations are followed.
essential: advise on environmental risk management systems
optional: carry out training in environmental matters
assess environmental plans against financial costs
mining, construction and civil engineering machinery products

esg: advise on environmental risk management systems
coaching: advise on environmental risk management systems

energy assessor.title: energy assessor
energy assessor.description: Energy assessors determine the energy performance of buildings. They create an Energy Performance Certificate (EPC) which indicates what the estimated energy consumption of a property is. Furthermore they give advice on how to improve energy conservation.
essential: advise on heating systems energy efficiency
carry out energy management of facilities
optional: provide information on geothermal heat pumps

coaching: advise on heating systems energy efficiency
energyaudit: advise on heating systems energy efficiency
carry out energy management of facilities

solar energy technician.title: solar energy technician
solar energy technician.description: Solar energy technicians install and maintain systems that collect solar energy. They prepare the necessary fixtures, often on roofs, install solar panels, and plug them into an electronic system including an inverter to connect the solar energy systems to the electricity lines.
essential: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety procedures when working at heights

electrical: follow health and safety procedures in construction
follow safety procedures when working at heights

executive assistant.title: executive assistant
executive assistant.description: Executive assistants are advanced administrative professionals who work with top-level executives or in international facilities in various industries. They organise meetings, organise and maintain files, arrange travel, train staff members, communicate in other languages, and manage the day-to-day operations of the office.
essential: communicate schedules to the people concerned

scheduling: communicate schedules to the people concerned

career guidance advisor.title: career guidance advisor
career guidance advisor.description: Career guidance advisors provide guidance and advice to adults and students on making educational, training and occupational choices and assist people in managing their careers, through career planning and career exploration. They help identify options for future careers, assist beneficiaries in the development of their curriculum and help people reflect on their ambitions, interests and qualifications. Career guidance advisors may provide advice on various career planning issues and make suggestions for lifelong learning if necessary, including study recommendations. They may also assist the individual in the search for a job.
essential: encourage counselled clients to examine themselves
optional: encourage students to acknowledge their achievements
organise projects to fill education needs

customer: encourage counselled clients to examine themselves
coaching: encourage counselled clients to examine themselves

customer contact centre information cler.title: customer contact centre information clerk
customer contact centre information cler.description: Customer contact centre information clerks provide information to customers via the telephone and other media such as email. They answer inquiries about a company's or oganisation's services, products and policies.

data scientist.title: data scientist
data scientist.description: Data scientists find and interpret rich data sources, manage large amounts of data, merge data sources, ensure consistency of data-sets, and create visualisations to aid in understanding data. They build mathematical models using data, present and communicate data insights and findings to specialists and scientists in their team and if required, to a non-expert audience, and recommend ways to apply the data.

chief data officer.title: chief data officer
chief data officer.description: Chief data officers manage companies' enterprise-wide data administration and data mining functions. They ensure data are used as a strategic business asset at the executive level and implement and support a more collaborative and aligned information management infrastructure for the benefit of the organisation at large.

ICT business analysis manager.title: ICT business analysis manager
ICT business analysis manager.description: ICT business analysis managers identify areas where information system changes are needed to support business plans and monitor the impact in terms of change management. They contribute to the general ICT functional requirements of the business organisation. ICT business analysis managers analyse business needs and translate them into ICT solutions.
essential: propose ICT solutions to business problems
optional: provide training on technological business developments

problem: propose ICT solutions to business problems

business manager.title: business manager
business manager.description: Business managers are responsible for setting the objectives of the business unit of a company, creating a plan for the operations, and facilitating the achievement of the objectives and implementation of the plan together with employees of the segment and stakeholders. They keep an overview of the business, understand detailed information of the business unit and support the department, and make decisions based on the information at hand.
essential: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
abide by business ethical code of conducts
get involved in the day-to-day operation of the company
assume responsibility for the management of a business
integrate strategic foundation in daily performance
plan medium to long term objectives
optional: show an exemplary leading role in an organisation
shape organisational teams based on competencies
integrate headquarter's guidelines into local operations
describe the financial situation of a region
report on overall management of a business
keep updated on the political landscape
interact with the board of directors

strategy: integrate strategic foundation in daily performance

ICT system architect.title: ICT system architect
ICT system architect.description: ICT system architects design architecture, components, modules, interfaces, and data for a multi-components system to meet specified requirements.

chief technology officer.title: chief technology officer
chief technology officer.description: Chief technology officers contribute to a company's technical vision and lead all aspects of technology development, according to its strategic direction and growth objectives. They match technology with business needs.
essential: review development process of an organisation
establish an ICT customer support process
ensure adherence to organisational ICT standards
maintain plan for continuity of operations
lead technology development of an organisation

customer: establish an ICT customer support process

ICT security manager.title: ICT security manager
ICT security manager.description: ICT security managers propose and implement necessary security updates. They advise, support, inform and provide training and security awareness and take direct action on all or part of a network or system.
essential: establish an ICT security prevention plan

cyber: establish an ICT security prevention plan

chief ICT security officer.title: chief ICT security officer
chief ICT security officer.description: Chief ICT security officers protect company and employee information against unauthorized access. They also define the Information System security policy, manage security deployment across all Information Systems and ensure the provision of information availability.
essential: ensure adherence to organisational ICT standards
maintain plan for continuity of operations

ICT help desk manager.title: ICT help desk manager
ICT help desk manager.description: ICT help desk managers monitor the delivery of technical support services to clients according to the predefined deadlines.  They plan and organise the user support actions and troubleshoot ICT problems and issues. ICT help desk managers supervise the help desk team ensuring that the customers get the appropriate feedback and support. They also participate in developing customer service guidelines and in reinforcing the team.
essential: keep up to date on product knowledge

ICT operations manager.title: ICT operations manager
ICT operations manager.description: ICT operations managers coordinate ICT services and infrastructure ensuring that the organisation has the required infrastructural resources. They also plan and monitor stages of either a business process or a computer process, negotiate contracts and take mitigation action in case of non-fulfilment of agreements. They oversee the day-to-day tasks involving infrastructure components, ICT systems and software.

eBusiness manager.title: eBusiness manager
eBusiness manager.description: eBusiness managers create and execute a company's electronic strategy plan for selling products and services online. They also improve data integrity, placement of online tools and brand exposure and monitor sales for companies that market products to customers using the internet. They collaborate with the marketing and sales management team using ICT tools to reach sales goals and provide accurate information and offerings to business partners.
optional: lead the brand strategic planning process

chief marketing officer.title: chief marketing officer
chief marketing officer.description: Chief marketing officers manage the high level marketing operations in a company. They coordinate all the efforts related to the marketing, promotional, and advertising activities across units or geographical areas. They make sure that different activities aimed at creating awareness of products are profitable for the company. They take decisions and prepare reports on marketing projects and the costs they entail.
essential: integrate marketing strategies with the global strategy

digimarketing: integrate marketing strategies with the global strategy
strategy: integrate marketing strategies with the global strategy

environmental programme coordinator.title: environmental programme coordinator
environmental programme coordinator.description: Environmental programme coordinators develop programmes for the improvement of environmental sustainability and efficiency within a organisation or institution. They inspect sites in order to monitor an organisation's or institution's compliance with environmental legislation. They also ensure education for the public on environmental concerns.
optional: carry out training in environmental matters

corporate social responsibility manager.title: corporate social responsibility manager
corporate social responsibility manager.description: Corporate social responsibility managers monitor the practices of organisations and companies with regard to ethics and impact on the larger community. They advise on social responsibility and sustainability matters depending on the company's needs. Corporate social responsibility managers promote actions that are environmentally conscious, philanthropic or related to human rights.
essential: advise on social responsibility and sustainability matters

coaching: advise on social responsibility and sustainability matters
esg: advise on social responsibility and sustainability matters

energy engineer.title: energy engineer
energy engineer.description: Energy engineers design new, efficient and clean ways to produce, transform, and distribute energy to improve environmental sustainability and energy efficiency. They extract energy through natural resources, such as oil or gas, or renewable and sustainable sources, such as wind or solar power.
optional: ensure regulatory compliance in pipeline infrastructures
ensure compliance with electricity distribution schedule
ensure compliance with gas distribution schedule
advise on environmental risk management systems
mitigate environmental impact of pipeline projects
heating, ventilation, air conditioning and refrigeration parts
ensure safety in electrical power operations
security requirements of goods transported via pipelines
advise on heating systems energy efficiency
carry out energy management of facilities
ensure compliance with waste legislative regulations

energy manager.title: energy manager
energy manager.description:
Energy managers coordinate the energy use in an organisation, and aim to implement policies for increased sustainability, and minimisation of cost and environmental impact. They monitor the energy demands 
and use, and develop improvement strategies, as well as researching the most beneficial source of energy for the organisation's needs.
essential: carry out energy management of facilities
advise on heating systems energy efficiency
optional: advise on potential safety hazards concerning heating systems

energyaudit: carry out energy management of facilities
advise on heating systems energy efficiency
coaching: advise on heating systems energy efficiency

solar energy engineer.title: solar energy engineer
solar energy engineer.description: Solar energy engineers design systems which generate electrical energy from sunlight, such as photovoltaic systems. They design and construct systems which optimise the energy output from solar power, and the sustainability of the production process of solar systems.

office manager.title: office manager
office manager.description:
\
Office managers oversee the administrative work that clerical workers are commissioned to perform in various types of organisations or associations. They perform micromanagement and maintain a close view of administrative processes such as such as controlling correspondence, designing filing systems, reviewing and approving supply requisitions, assigning and monitoring clerical functions. They report to managers within the same department or to general managers in companies, depending on their size.
essential: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement

chief operating officer.title: chief operating officer
chief operating officer.description: Chief operating officers are the right hand and second in command of a company's chief executive officer. They ensure that the daily operations of the company run smoothly. Chief operating officers also develop company policies, rules and goals.
essential: show an exemplary leading role in an organisation
integrate strategic foundation in daily performance
abide by business ethical code of conducts
get involved in the day-to-day operation of the company
shape organisational teams based on competencies
plan medium to long term objectives
optional: analyse financial performance of a company
interact with the board of directors
assume responsibility for the management of a business
integrate shareholders' interests in business plans
imprint visionary aspirations into the business management

strategy: integrate strategic foundation in daily performance

public employment service manager.title: public employment service manager
public employment service manager.description: Public employment service managers supervise the operations of a public employment agency. They oversee the staff that helps people find employment or provide occupational guidance.
essential: promote gender equality in business contexts

human resources manager.title: human resources manager
human resources manager.description: Human resources managers plan, design and implement processes related to the human capital of companies. They develop programs for recruiting, interviewing, and selecting employees based on a previous assessment of the profile and skills required in the company. Moreover, they manage compensation and development programs for the company's employees comprising trainings, skill assessment and yearly evaluations, promotion, expat programs, and general assurance of the well-being of the employees in the workplace.
essential: promote gender equality in business contexts
plan medium to long term objectives
optional: provide advice on breaches of regulation
monitor developments in field of expertise

contact centre supervisor.title: contact centre supervisor
contact centre supervisor.description: Contact centre supervisors oversee and coordinate the activities of contact centre employees. They ensure that daily operations run smoothly through resolving issues, instructing and training employees and supervising tasks.
optional: create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement

call centre manager.title: call centre manager
call centre manager.description: Call centre managers set the objectives of the service per month, week, and day. They perform micromanagement of the results obtained in the centre in order to proactively react with plans, trainings, or motivational plans depending on the problems faced by the service. They strive for achievement of KPIs such as minimum operating time, sales per day, and compliance with quality parameters.
essential: report on overall management of a business
create a work atmosphere of continuous improvement
assess the feasibility of implementing developments
supervise the management of an establishment
manage key performance indicators of call centres

problem: assess the feasibility of implementing developments
leadership: supervise the management of an establishment

office clerk.title: office clerk
office clerk.description: Office clerks are responsible for performing clerical and administrative duties in an office setting and support of business operations within a department. They assist all the administrative staff, secretaries, and assistants by sorting mail, filing forms and documents, answering phones, greeting clients, scheduling meetings, and serving drinks.

bookkeeper.title: bookkeeper
bookkeeper.description: Bookkeepers record and assemble the day-to-day financial transactions of an organisation or company, consisting usually of sales, purchases, payments and receipts. They ensure all financial transactions are documented in the appropriate (day) book and general ledger, and that they are balanced out. Bookkeepers prepare the recorded books and ledgers with financial transactions for an accountant to then analyse balance sheets and income statements.
essential: attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions
optional: archive documentation related to the work

bookkeeping: attach accounting certificates to accounting transactions

secretary.title: secretary
secretary.description: Secretaries perform a variety of administrative tasks to help keep an organisation run smoothly. They answer telephone calls, draft and send e-mails, maintain diaries, arrange appointments, take messages, file documents, organise and service meetings, and manage databases.
essential: communicate schedules to the people concerned
optional: place orders for printed paper goods
develop documentation in accordance with legal requirements

scheduling: communicate schedules to the people concerned

administrative assistant.title: administrative assistant
administrative assistant.description: Administrative assistants perform administrative and office support for supervisors. They perform a variety of tasks, such as answering telephone calls, receiving and directing visitors, ordering office supplies, maintaining the office facilities running smoothly, and ensuring that equipment and appliances work properly.

customer service representative.title: customer service representative
customer service representative.description: Customer service representatives handle complaints and are responsible for maintaining overall goodwill between an organisation and its customers. They manage data regarding customer satisfaction and report it.
essential: process order forms with customer's information
perform multiple tasks at the same time

customer: process order forms with customer's information

call centre agent.title: call centre agent
call centre agent.description: Call centre agents handle incoming or outgoing customer calls for a business. They call existing and prospective customers to promote goods and services. They also obtain sales and arrange sales visits.
essential: perform multiple tasks at the same time
optional: apply operations for an ITIL-based environment

data entry clerk.title: data entry clerk
data entry clerk.description: Data entry clerks update, maintain and retrieve information held on computer systems. They prepare source data for computer entry by compiling and sorting information, process customer and account source documents by reviewing data for deficiencies and verify entered customer and account data.

shop assistant.title: shop assistant
shop assistant.description: Shop assistants work in shops where they perform assistance duties. The help shopkeepers in their daily work such as ordering and refilling of goods and stock, providing general advice to customers, selling products and maintaining the shop.
essential: arrange ordering of products for customers
provide customer guidance on product selection

customer: arrange ordering of products for customers
provide customer guidance on product selection
coaching: provide customer guidance on product selection

receptionist.title: receptionist
receptionist.description: Receptionists are responsible for the reception area of a business. They answer the phone, greet guests, pass information, respond to inquiries and instruct visitors. They are the first point of contact for clients and customers.
optional: develop documentation in accordance with legal requirements

warehouse worker.title: warehouse worker
warehouse worker.description: Warehouse workers execute the accurate handling, packing and storage of materials in a warehouse. They receive goods, label them, check quality, store the goods and document any damage. Warehouse workers also monitor stock levels of items, keep inventory and ship goods.
essential: match goods with appropriate packaging according to security procedures
apply techniques for stacking goods into containers
handle paperwork related to warehouse stock
types of packaging used in industrial shipments
assist in the movement of heavy loads
secure goods according to work orders
implement efficiency plans for logistics operations
optional: apply procedures to ensure cargo complies with customs regulations
